metadata.title: Renaissance Technologies' Top Q2 2026 Move: Meta Platforms Inc at a 1.37% Portfolio Impact

content.text:
This article first appeared on GuruFocus.
Quant Giant's 698% Stake Surge in Meta Leads a Quarter of Bold Bets and Strategic Exits
Renaissance Technologies (Trades, Portfolio) LLC, the legendary quantitative hedge fund founded by Jim Simons in 1978, recently disclosed its second-quarter 2026 13F filing. Known for its systematic, data-driven trading strategies, the firm employs complex mathematical models to identify non-random price movements across global markets. Following Simons' passing in May 2024, the firm continues to operate under its established quantitative framework, managing a portfolio of 3,142 stocks this quarter. The filing reveals a dynamic period of aggressive accumulation, significant position increases, and decisive exits, with the most impactful move being a massive expansion in Meta Platforms Inc (NASDAQ:META).
Summary of New Buys
Renaissance Technologies (Trades, Portfolio) added a total of 549 stocks to its portfolio during the quarter. The most significant additions include:
-
The largest new position was CrowdStrike Holdings Inc (NASDAQ:CRWD), with 748,960 shares, accounting for 0.79% of the portfolio and a total value of $571.56 million.
-
The second largest addition was Amazon.com Inc (NASDAQ:AMZN), consisting of 2,290,710 shares, representing approximately 0.75% of the portfolio, with a total value of $545.97 million.
-
The third largest addition was Medtronic PLC (NYSE:MDT), with 3,167,741 shares, accounting for 0.34% of the portfolio and a total value of $247.81 million.
Key Position Increases
Beyond new entries, Renaissance Technologies (Trades, Portfolio) increased stakes in 1,086 existing holdings. The most notable increases were:
-
The most significant increase was Meta Platforms Inc (NASDAQ:META), with an additional 1,769,780 shares, bringing the total to 2,023,153 shares. This adjustment represents a substantial 698.49% increase in share count, a 1.37% impact on the current portfolio, and a total value of $1.14 billion.
-
The second largest increase was NVIDIA Corp (NASDAQ:NVDA), with an additional 4,564,308 shares, bringing the total to 7,091,256. This adjustment represents a significant 180.63% increase in share count and a total value of $1.42 billion.
Summary of Sold Out Positions
Renaissance Technologies (Trades, Portfolio) completely exited 620 holdings in the second quarter of 2026, signaling a strategic reshuffling of its portfolio. Key exits include:
